stills.caption: The first talk of the day opens on a new line from the mod's talk pools, picked for the villager's personality.
The next page is the villager's own hello: the mod's line comes first, and the game's conversation carries on as usual.
Talk again the same day and there is no mod line: one new line per villager per day.

film.caption: Twiggy's first talk of the day opens on the mod's line, then her own words; a second talk skips straight to her hello.
